discovery: The first full preparation attempt aborted because 66 official FinQA train reports expose only 6-9 unique retrieved_all units, not exactly 10.
implementation_incidents: The first JSON patch placed the variable-count fields under internal_validation instead of training_boundary; strict Pydantic validation rejected it before training.
The retriever selector initially referenced an out-of-scope artifact name; an end-to-end selector test exposed it and the implementation now uses self._artifact.
An initial pair-count-versus-feature-count guard was removed because positive L2 regularization makes the normal-equation system invertible even when the pair count is smaller than the feature count.
protocol_status_interpretation: The corrected protocol was frozen before the first successful training and before any cross-validation outcome was observed.
